title: McpTools
description: C2 (draft): MCP tools the core exposes to any agent runtime (Claude Code, plugins of other runtimes, the Agent SDK engine). `x-tools` lists the tools; their input and output schemas are in `$defs`.

HiveCreateOutput.description: The card a create made or found by its idempotency key.

created.description: False when `idem_key` named an existing card.

card_class.description: The card's class as the hive stored it: `series_run` for a series (whose own card waits in `blocked` and makes one card per period).

owner_visible.description: Whether the owner hears every result of the card.

HiveCreateInput.description: Create a Hive card: the fields of `hive.py create` a delegation may set. Exactly one of `acceptance` and `accept_review`. The caller is not an input: the server sets `created_by` from its config. No field names a script, an executor, a model, a delivery or a path; the result always comes back to the secretary through the owner inbox. Timing is the hive's own scheduler (ADR-0082): `not_before` holds a one-off card until a time; with `reminder` the card is a reminder, whose exact text falls due then and runs no head; `every` or `cron` (with `tz`) make a series that creates one card per period, bounded by `until` or `max_runs` (`every` needs one of them); `recheck_every` with `recheck_until` or `recheck_max` re-runs the acceptance of a done card and reports when it fails (a watcher of a condition). Times are RFC 3339 with an offset, durations `Ns`, `Nm`, `Nh` or `Nd`.

details.description: Further context for the head, the card's body (`--body`).

acceptance.description: Mechanical acceptance: a bash command run in the card workspace, exit 0 = pass. A bare `test -s REPORT.md` needs `review`; for criteria a judge checks use `accept_review` instead.

accept_review.description: Criteria the judge checks the report against, instead of `acceptance` (`--accept-review`; the gate is a non-empty `REPORT.md`). Judge only: it adds no reviewer; set `review` for one.

source.description: Where the request came from (`--source`), such as `msg:<id>`, `issue:<n>` or `manual`.

kind.description: Card class (`--kind`); default `owner_task`. Leave it out with `every` or `cron`: a series is `series_run`.

review.description: Independent review by the other vendor (`--review`). Off by default; only `review: true` turns it on, never `accept_review`, `kind` or `step`. Set it for code cards (pull requests, code changes) first, for complex research that needs a second check, and for anything else the author decides to review; small errands (look, switch, check a status) go without.

urgent.description: The owner waits for this result now (`--urgent`): the card runs on the hive's urgent lane, past its IO gate and above its concurrency, at most two such cards at once. Only for a card of the owner's own request on the main chat; the engine refuses it on any other turn (ADR-0103). Only with kind `owner_task` (the default) and a head: not with `every`, `cron` or `reminder`.

hold.description: Park the card until the owner runs `hive.py release`. Not with `not_before`, `every` or `cron`.

owner_visible.description: Notify the owner about the result; default by class. A series (`series_run`) reports only news unless this is true.

idem_key.description: Idempotency key of the request: a second create with it returns the first card.

not_before.description: Hold the card until this time, then run it once (`--not-before`): RFC 3339 with an offset, such as `2026-11-27T09:00:00+03:00`. With `every` or `cron` the first period starts then. Not with `hold`.

every.description: Make a series: one card per period of this length (`--every`), `Ns`, `Nm`, `Nh` or `Nd` up to 366 days, such as `15m`. Needs `until` or `max_runs`; not with `cron`, `kind`, `hold` or a recheck.

cron.description: Make a series on a five-field cron schedule (`--cron`), such as `*/15 9-18 * * 1-5` or `0 9 * * *`; minute hour day month weekday, single spaces. Unbounded unless `until` or `max_runs`; not with `every`, `kind`, `hold` or a recheck.

tz.description: IANA time zone of `cron` (`--tz`), such as `Europe/Moscow`; default the hive's owner zone. Only with `cron`.

until.description: No period of the series starts at or after this time (`--until`): RFC 3339 with an offset. Only with `every` or `cron`.

max_runs.description: At most this many cards of the series (`--max-runs`). Only with `every` or `cron`.

recheck_every.description: After the card is done, run its acceptance again every this long (`--recheck-every`), `Ns`, `Nm`, `Nh` or `Nd` up to 366 days; a failed recheck blocks the card and reports it. Needs `recheck_until` or `recheck_max`; not with `every` or `cron`.

recheck_until.description: No recheck at or after this time (`--recheck-until`): RFC 3339 with an offset. Only with `recheck_every`.

recheck_max.description: At most this many rechecks (`--recheck-max`). Only with `recheck_every`.

reminder.description: Make the card a reminder (`--reminder`): this exact text, verbatim, falls due at `not_before` (or each period of `every` or `cron`, or when the owner releases a `hold`) and comes back to you as a `reminder_due` event to claim, then send or withdraw with `hive_reminder`; no head runs. Not blank, at most 32768 bytes of UTF-8. Give `acceptance` `true`; not with `accept_review`, `review` or a recheck.

result_line.description: First line of the card's result once it has one (the outcome, a block or a cancel reason), at most 500 characters.

report_line.description: First line of the last head report, at most 500 characters.

HiveListInput.description: List cards, newest first; every filter given must hold.

state.description: Filter by state; without it cancelled cards are left out.

parent.description: Only the children of this epic (`--parent`).

followup_of.description: Only the followups of this card (`--followup-of`).

placement.description: `board`: cards on the board or in its archive; `hidden`: the rules of schedules and series and the series runs without a followup link (`--placement`).

query.description: Case-insensitive text in the title or goal (`--query`).

HiveSteerInput.description: Send a steering note to the head working on a card.

note.description: Note text the head gets in its session or its next round.

HiveCancelInput.description: Cancel a card; its active heads are stopped.

HiveResolveInput.description: Decide a disputed card (state blocked, wait disputed) as its author: accept finishes it done with the head's result, rework queues a new round.

action.description: `accept`: the dispute is right, the card is done. `rework`: a new round follows `text`.

text.description: Why (accept) or the instructions of the next round (rework), kept on the card.

HiveReminderInput.description: Act on a due reminder or watchdog alert (a card waiting `blocked`, wait `reminder`): claim it first, then send it as is or edited, or withdraw it with a reason.

action.description: `claim`: take a `due` one, which stops the hive's own send while you decide. `send`: send a claimed one to the owner through Telegram, the original text or `text`. `withdraw`: drop a claimed one with `reason`; nothing is sent.

text.description: Only with `send`: the text the owner gets instead of the original, verbatim. Not blank, at most 32768 bytes of UTF-8.

reason.description: Only with `withdraw`, and required there: why the owner does not get it, kept on the card.

HiveInspectOutput.description: A read-only snapshot of one card from the inside at the time of the call (the hive's `inspect --json`, version 2): the summary fields, then `snapshot` with `card` (fields, goal, acceptance, result, judge feedback), `links` (parent, children, followup_of, followups, blocked_by, blocks, series), `rounds` (per round every run with role, vendor, model, effort, unit, start, end, outcome, verdict and report; the gate's result and output; the judge's verdict and reason; the round's retry, block or finish), `heads` (each live run: its unit, its processes, the commands it waits on and for how long, the other units those name, the pull requests and workflow runs they wait on with their checks), `queue` (board column and wait, position in the launch queue, the slots it waits for, `concurrency` or for an urgent card the urgent lane, and their holders, budget wait), `steers` (text and delivery), `deliveries` (outbox row and owner inbox status and outcome) and `files` (the workspace's entries, each a path `hive_file` reads).

result_line.description: First line of the card's result, at most 500 characters.

report_line.description: First line of the last head report, at most 500 characters.

waiting_on.description: One line on what a live head waits on: the command, how long it has run, and the pull requests or workflow runs it names; absent without a live head.

snapshot.description: The whole snapshot (see the definition's description).

HiveHealthOutput.description: A read-only snapshot of the hive as a whole at the time of the call (the hive's `health --json`, version 2): the summary fields, then `snapshot` with `config` (concurrency, ladder of models and efforts per step, vendors, executors, timeouts, budgets; no paths, environments, commands or texts), `dispatcher` (last tick and its summary), `resource_gate`, `weekly_left`, `provider_cooldowns`, `cards_by_state`, `slots` (every head run, board card or not: series runs, reviewers, each marked `urgent` on the urgent lane above `concurrency` with its own count `urgent_used` of `urgent_max` cards; scripts; external jobs; gate jobs), `queue` (the launch order), `series` (each schedule or series: rule, next start, runs, last runs, whether one holds a slot) and `outbox` (unpublished count, the latest events with their owner inbox status).

ticking.description: The dispatcher ticked within the last 120 s.

tick_age_s.description: Seconds since the dispatcher's last tick; absent when it never ticked.

slots_used.description: Head runs holding one of the `concurrency` slots now; urgent runs hold none.

concurrency.description: The head slots of the config.

queue_length.description: Cards waiting for a head slot.

snapshot.description: The whole snapshot (see the definition's description).

HiveFileInput.description: Read one file or list one directory of a card's workspace, read-only: a relative path inside it, or `@out/<name>` for a results file the card's own goal, details or acceptance names. No `..`, no absolute path, no symlink, no name that looks like a secret (`.env`, `token`, `key`, ...).

path.description: Relative path in the workspace, such as `REPORT.md`, `ev/log.txt` or `ev`; or `@out/<name>`.

offset.description: Byte offset to start reading at; default 0.

limit.description: At most this many bytes; default and maximum 262144.

HiveFileOutput.description: A file's text (UTF-8, invalid bytes replaced) from `offset`, or a directory's entries.

truncated.description: More of the file follows the text.

GardenFact.description: A fact as returned to the agent (same shape as C7 `Fact`).

GatePendingOutput.description: Gate previews waiting for the owner.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes shown.
